name: workpay
description: WorkPay – Worker Shift, Overtime & Payroll Management Platform

scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.build:apk: cd client && npm run build && npx cap copy && cd android && export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17 && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../WorkPay-debug.apk
scripts.open:android: cd client && npx cap open android
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
